A couple of general-purpose calculators that don't have a notebook chapter behind them (yet).

## 4-band resistor color code

```{=html}
<div id="calc-resistor-code"></div>
<script src="../assets/js/calc-engine.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  var digitColors = [
    { value: "black", label: "Black (0)" },
    { value: "brown", label: "Brown (1)" },
    { value: "red", label: "Red (2)" },
    { value: "orange", label: "Orange (3)" },
    { value: "yellow", label: "Yellow (4)" },
    { value: "green", label: "Green (5)" },
    { value: "blue", label: "Blue (6)" },
    { value: "violet", label: "Violet (7)" },
    { value: "gray", label: "Gray (8)" },
    { value: "white", label: "White (9)" }
  ];
  var multiplierColors = digitColors.concat([
    { value: "gold", label: "Gold (×0.1)" },
    { value: "silver", label: "Silver (×0.01)" }
  ]);
  var toleranceColors = [
    { value: "brown", label: "Brown (±1%)" },
    { value: "red", label: "Red (±2%)" },
    { value: "green", label: "Green (±0.5%)" },
    { value: "blue", label: "Blue (±0.25%)" },
    { value: "violet", label: "Violet (±0.1%)" },
    { value: "gray", label: "Gray (±0.05%)" },
    { value: "gold", label: "Gold (±5%)" },
    { value: "silver", label: "Silver (±10%)" }
  ];
  var digitValue = { black: 0, brown: 1, red: 2, orange: 3, yellow: 4, green: 5, blue: 6, violet: 7, gray: 8, white: 9 };
  var multiplierExp = { black: 0, brown: 1, red: 2, orange: 3, yellow: 4, green: 5, blue: 6, violet: 7, gray: 8, white: 9, gold: -1, silver: -2 };
  var toleranceValue = { brown: 1, red: 2, green: 0.5, blue: 0.25, violet: 0.1, gray: 0.05, gold: 5, silver: 10 };

  function formatOhms(ohms) {
    if (ohms >= 1e6) return (ohms / 1e6).toFixed(3).replace(/\.?0+$/, "") + " MΩ";
    if (ohms >= 1e3) return (ohms / 1e3).toFixed(3).replace(/\.?0+$/, "") + " kΩ";
    return ohms.toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, "") + " Ω";
  }

  Calc.create({
    root: "calc-resistor-code",
    inputs: [
      { id: "b1", label: "Band 1", type: "select", value: "brown", options: digitColors },
      { id: "b2", label: "Band 2", type: "select", value: "black", options: digitColors },
      { id: "b3", label: "Band 3 (multiplier)", type: "select", value: "red", options: multiplierColors },
      { id: "b4", label: "Band 4 (tolerance)", type: "select", value: "gold", options: toleranceColors }
    ],
    outputs: [
      { id: "value", label: "Resistance" },
      { id: "tol", label: "Tolerance" }
    ],
    compute: function (v) {
      var digits = digitValue[v.b1] * 10 + digitValue[v.b2];
      var ohms = digits * Math.pow(10, multiplierExp[v.b3]);
      var tol = toleranceValue[v.b4];
      return { value: formatOhms(ohms), tol: "±" + tol + "%" };
    }
  });
})();
</script>
```

## Capacitor charge and stored energy

```{=html}
<div id="calc-cap-energy"></div>
<script>
Calc.create({
  root: "calc-cap-energy",
  inputs: [
    { id: "C", label: "Capacitance (µF)", value: 100, min: 0, step: 1 },
    { id: "V", label: "Voltage (V)", value: 12, min: 0, step: 0.1 }
  ],
  outputs: [
    { id: "Q", label: "Charge Q = CV" },
    { id: "E", label: "Energy E = ½CV²" }
  ],
  compute: function (v) {
    var C = v.C * 1e-6;
    var Q = C * v.V;
    var E = 0.5 * C * v.V * v.V;
    var Qtxt = Math.abs(Q) < 1e-3 ? (Q * 1e6).toFixed(2) + " µC" : (Q * 1000).toFixed(3) + " mC";
    var Etxt = Math.abs(E) < 1e-3 ? (E * 1e6).toFixed(2) + " µJ" : (E * 1000).toFixed(3) + " mJ";
    return { Q: Qtxt, E: Etxt };
  }
});
</script>
```
